messages:
linh: Heads-up: BlueNova dedicated pool bring-up moved to tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and load-test owner. Renewal flagged if onboarding slips >3 business days.

jordan: Noted. Can we get expected sustained RPS and peak? Also what percent of traffic is embeddings vs gen?

linh: Sustained 220 RPS, peaks ~650 for short blasts. Embeddings ~15% of calls, gen 85%. Latency target p95 <= 300ms for gen endpoints, embeddings p95 <= 120ms.

marco: Model is redwood/titan-embed-quant:v1 for embeddings and redwood/llama-optimized:v3 for gen. I'll pre-warm embedding tables and push an optimized kernel set. Priming runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bluenova/priming.md 

carla: I'll own the functional smoke and the load tests. Need a temporary quota bump: +25% for 3h. Also need service account with read-only access to logs.

opsbot: Reminder: BlueNova bring-up scheduled in ~20h. Confirm owners 12h prior to event.

jordan: Proposed autoscale policy:
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 3,
  "max_replicas": 12,
  "scale_up_threshold_rps": 150,
  "scale_down_threshold_rps": 60,
  "cooldown_s": 90
}
```
Allow temporary overcommit for first 1h of ramp.

marco: Load harness (k6):
```bash
k6 run --vus 300 --duration 15m scripts/bluenova-mixed.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
Repo: git://infra/load-scripts/bluenova-mixed.js

carla: Smoke done: priming complete, embeddings p95=95ms, gen p95=260ms, p99 spikes to 480ms during a 30s peak. Error-rate 0.6%. Uploading logs: https://s3.redwood/bluenova/warmup-2026-03-23-08am.zip

linh: Good catch on p99. We'll keep monitoring for 24h. Carla, escalation path if >1% errors?

carla: Escalate to @jordan and @linh. I'll also email the Cerulex (typo: BlueNova) engineering contact for CORS/key verifications.

jordan: Approved +25% quota for 3h starting at ramp. I'll annotate metrics and rollback autoscale after the window. If error-rate >1% for sustained 2m, auto-pager triggers.

opsbot: Reminder: post-run submit quick notes to /csm/notes within 4h.

linh: Owners: carla(smoke), marco(priming), jordan(autoscale). We'll track renewal risk; if warmup fails, we'll request an exec check-in. Thanks team.
